id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

edge.description: Whether or not the shape is an edge

vertex.description: Whether or not the shape is a vertex

srid.description:
Coordinate system for points stored in geometry column.

Interesting SRIDS:
   0 (Unknown)
   4326 (e.g. WGS84 Lat/Long - Used by Google Earth)
   3857 (e.g. Spherical Mercator - Used by Google Maps)

x.description: The X coordinate of the point. In most long/lat systems, this is the longitude.

y.description: The Y coordinate of the point. In most long/lat systems, this is the latitude.

minimized.description: Whether or not the node should be minimized when rendered on the {@link UiSdlDiagram}

expandable.description: Whether or not the node is expandable. Will determine if a collapse/expand toggle is rendered with the node.

expanded.description: Whether or not the node should be expanded or collapesed when rendered on the {@link UiSdlDiagram}

connectable.description:
Whether or not the node should be connectable when rendered on the {@link UiSdlDiagram}.
Determines if new edges can be created between 2 given nodes via drag and drop.

diagramProps.description: Props passed to SDLDiagram by {@link UiSdlDiagram}, which the node can make use of.

diagramScale.description:
The current scale of the diagram. Decimal representation of the % zoom shown in the UI (80% -> .8, 110% -> 1.1).
It is up to the node to decide how to handle it.

nodeActions.description:
Actions associated with the node. If utilizing {@link UiSdlActionGroup#dropdownContent}, when a dropdown
item is clicked, the actionSuffix will be a concatenation with `_` of the {@link UiSdlActionGroup#actionSuffix} and
the item's {@link UiSdlAction#actionSuffix}, ex: `DROPDOWN_ITEM`.

contextMenuItems.description: Context menu items to show on the node
